name: ooc-language
description: Edit, navigate, and check Object-Oriented Circuits (.ckt) files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Editing and navigation work in Restricted Mode. Circuit commands run the local OOC compiler in a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Circuit commands operate on saved local files.

ooc.autoUpdate.description: Check for installed OOC application updates, or apply local extension releases when using a development checkout.

ooc.refreshOnSave.description: Refresh the running schematic after saving a circuit or included file in its OOC project.

ooc.hoverPreviews.description: Show gate/chip pin diagrams and highlighted wire previews on hover using the local OOC compiler.

ooc.projectRoot.description: Path to the OOC checkout when editing circuits in a separate folder.

ooc.installationPath.description: Optional custom OOC installer location. The standard per-user installation is detected automatically.

ooc.pythonPath.description: Python executable for the OOC compiler. Defaults to the checkout's .venv when available.
